Looking for challenging role? If you really want to make a difference - make it with us

Protection & Control Engineer is responsible for relay protection and control engineering activities, including basic design and check of detail design for high voltage substation and transmission projects.

Your new role - challenging and future-oriented:

  • Perform analysis and design of single line diagram.
  • Develop concept of substation relaying & metering diagrams (i.e. A.C. schematic diagrams), and D.C. Schematic for basic design.
  • Responsible to produce protection and control designs for LVAC, LVDC and UPS equipment associated with LTS.
  • Responsible for the production C.T./V.T. and cable sizing calculations.
